incident: outcome leak in a P4E candidate feature, found by inspection before any candidate was judged
defect: computed as (previous team-game's total RB carry share) - (the CURRENT game's own realised share). The current-game outcome therefore entered the ridge design linearly.
how_found: block C alone improved pooled carry CRPS by 25.9% (2.0206 -> 1.4976) and E_ABC by 37.0%. An allocation-only change cannot plausibly recover that much; the feature was read and the leak was visible on one line.
status: FIXED. own PREVIOUS-game share is now subtracted. The contaminated numbers above are recorded as an incident and are not results.
